title: DEWP Execution Evidence Statement
description: The object an evidence source signs about whether an approved action took effect (DEWP §4.7.2). Structural validation only: the statement bytes MUST also equal their own RFC 8785 serialization, every number MUST be portable (§4.3.1), every number MUST have magnitude at most 2^53 − 1, nesting MUST NOT exceed 64 levels, the bytes MUST NOT exceed 16,384, `sampledAt` MUST NOT be later than `observedAt`, and `source` MUST equal the Evidence Record's signerDid. A valid statement reports what its source observed, not what physically happened.

nonce.description: The DIV nonce of the approval the evidence is about.

payloadSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of that approval's DIV Intent Payload.

observation.description: Domain-specific observation, covered by the signature and not interpreted by verifiers (DEWP Appendix A).

observedAt.description: When the source produced the statement, in the DEWP §4.3 timestamp form. The measurement time is sampledAt.

sampledAt.description: When the measurement behind the observation was taken (DEWP §4.3 form); not later than observedAt. The evidence window is evaluated on it.

sequence.description: The source's own gapless count of statements signed for this producer's log, incremented by exactly one per statement and never reused (DEWP §4.7.2 rule 12).

source.description: The evidence source's identifier; equals the Evidence Record's signerDid.

verdict.description: confirmed: the approved effect was observed. contradicted: it was observed not to take effect, or to take a different effect.
